value.reason: The call `res.cookie('token', token)` passes no options object, so Express applies none of the protective attributes: httpOnly is unset (the token is readable by client-side JavaScript, so an XSS flaw could steal it), secure is unset (it can be sent over plain HTTP), and sameSite is unset (it is sent on cross-site requests). Because this is an authentication token, the missing flags are a real risk. The verdict would change only if a wrapper or global configuration outside this snippet sets these flags, and nothing in the evidence shows that.
